result:
All 14 queries ran and gave the answers below. A few notes on how they work:
- **Rounding:** qlang has no round verb. H2 and H10 round by scaling, adding 0.5, cutting the printed number at the ".", parsing it back and scaling down. That is half-up rounding for the non-negative values here.
- **Sort order:** H5, H13 and H14 order descending by sorting ascending and then using `reverse`. H5 gets the id tie-break from a combined key, `comments*1000000 - id`. H14 pre-sorts the words descending and relies on `sort` being stable, which I didn't confirm. H13 breaks no score ties, because none of the scores tie.
- **H8–H11:** these read raw text, so they must be run with `--raw`.
- **Output format:** with `--raw`, H8, H10 and H11 print their keys as keywords (for example `:auth`), not quoted strings. Without `--raw`, the other object results print as JSON.

H1: filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(/country | lower | eq "de") | filter ~(coalesce ~(/age | type | eq ::number) ~(false)) | filter ~(/age | gte 30) * /name | sort
H2: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") * /items | flat * mul /qty /price | sum | mul 100 | add 0.5 | print | split "." | first | parse | apply / | div 100
H3: groupBy ~(/customer | lower) * count
H4: {:name /name :depCount (/dependencies | count) :devDepCount (/devDependencies | count) :scripts (/scripts | keys * print * (split ":" | drop 1 | join ":") | sort)}
H5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~(sub (/comments | mul 1000000) /id) | reverse | take 3 * /id
H6: * (coalesce ~(/labels) ~([])) | flat * lower | distinct | sort
H7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(coalesce ~(/assignee/login) ~("unassigned")) * count
H8: lines * split " " | filter ~(count | gt 2) | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2) * count
H9: lines * split " " | filter ~(count | gt 2) | filter ~(or (/1 | eq "ERROR") (/1 | eq "WARN")) * (drop 3 | filter ~(startsWith "user=")) | flat * (split "=" | /1) | distinct | sort
H10: lines | drop 1 * split "," | filter ~(count | gt 4) | filter ~(/4 | lower | eq "up") | filter ~(/2 | eq "" | not) | groupBy ~(/1) * (* (/2 | parse | apply /) | div (sum) (count) | mul 10 | add 0.5 | print | split "." | first | parse | apply / | div 10)
H11: lines | filter ~(lower | startsWith "db_") * split "=" | indexBy ~(/0 | lower | split "_" | drop 1 | join "_") * (drop 1 | join "=")
H12: :d /defaults/timeout | /services | filter ~(/enabled | eq true) | sort ~(/name) * {:name /name :timeout (coalesce ~(/timeout) ~(d)) :team (coalesce ~(/owner/team) ~("none"))}
H13: /results | filter ~(coalesce ~(/score | type | eq ::number) ~(false)) | filter ~(/score | gte 50) | sort ~(/score) | reverse * ([/profile/first " " /profile/last ": " (coalesce ~(/tags) ~([]) | join "|")] | join "")
H14: "The cat saw the dog; a Dog saw THE cat and a bird. Bird, dog!" | lower | split " " * (split ";" | join "" | split "," | join "" | split "." | join "" | split "!" | join "") | :ws / | distinct * (:w / | {:word w :count (ws | filter ~(eq w) | count)}) | sort ~(/word) | reverse | sort ~(/count) | reverse | take 3
